_metadata.description: Single-source story contracts for preview, generated controls, fixtures, and catalog tests.

requirements.title: Every catalog version owns one validated story contract
requirements.description: Every eligible authored component and hook version contains exactly one schemaVersioned story.json. It owns one public args or hook-input schema and named stories provide only valid values, fixtures, interactions, expectations, and documented composition references.

requirements.title: Generated controls validate one public input boundary
requirements.description: The workbench renders controls from the asset-level schema, validates edits before rendering, retains the last valid specimen on failure, and does not use raw JSON as its default editing path.

validation.notes: ComponentInspectorEditors tests cover story-args controls, apply/reset, and malformed or non-object JSON rejection. story-override-validation tests execute the harness validator for declared text, enum, numeric range, and required fields; FixtureFrame tests cover scoped override delivery and surfaced schema rejection. Remaining implementation gaps: the controls are seeded from current story args while raw JSON is exposed by default, and a rejected override hides the previous specimen instead of keeping it visibly available.
Executes the harness's actual story-field override validator and verifies allowed values plus type, enum, range, and required-field violations.
Verifies scoped override delivery to the selected iframe and host rendering of the harness's schema-rejection response.

requirements.title: State and external dependencies remain explicit and safe
requirements.description: Internal state is reached through real interactions or public controlled/default APIs. External state uses only declared provider or adapter fixtures. Contracts cannot execute setup, imports, functions, arbitrary hook mutation, storage writes, or network side effects.

requirements.title: The cutover is complete and legacy preview metadata is rejected
requirements.description: The deterministic conformance report covers every authored library version and fails missing story.json, obsolete examples.json, controls, setup, invalid values, undeclared fixtures, and raw node-tag corruption. The catalog story lint command reports zero current diagnostics across the authored corpus.
